war_choice.source: warstudy.py on the war logs of game3, game4: each city the human took (K lines) with more than one city of the target that turn (Y lines); options: those cities; a cue's best options: its least value (defenders, defence modifier, distance to the human's cities including those taken before in the war, size) or most foreign units near; a pair of cues: the second decides among the first's best (take-the-best, Gigerenzer, Heuristics, chapter 14); maximum-likelihood classification with one error rate per cue (Bröder, in Heuristics, chapter 17), e on a grid of hundredths; guessing: each option 1/m; chosen_was_best counts ties as hits
